verified: CNBC reported, citing people familiar with the details, that Anthropic is weighing an upsized IPO priced well above $80 a share, versus a prior $70–$78 range.
unconfirmed: that the deal will actually be upsized, the final price, the number of shares, total proceeds, the implied valuation, the pricing date, and any comment from Anthropic itself — all of these rest on unnamed sources.

verified: CNBC 报道称，据知情人士透露，Anthropic 正在权衡扩大 IPO 并上调定价，此前公布的区间为每股 70 至 78 美元。
unconfirmed: 定价“远高于 80 美元”与扩大发行规模目前都只有匿名消息人士的说法，Anthropic 未予确认；报道也没有给出新的发行股数、募资总额、上调后的确切价格或上市日期。

titles.en: Anthropic weighs upsizing IPO with price above $80, CNBC reports
titles.zh: Anthropic 据报考虑扩大 IPO 规模，定价或远超 80 美元
